name: Operation Deep-Dive Treasure
description: {{Description |title = 30px Operation Deep-Dive Treasure |Shipping accidents have been on the rise recently, pushing the local waters past a critical threshold. The cargo that sank beneath the waves has driven all manner of creatures into a frenzy, making these waters perilous, but also opening the door to unusual opportunities. By salvaging lost cargo, searching for treasure, and capturing frenzied creatures to bring back to the Wingalet for care, we can help restore the waters to their natural state while bringing considerable benefits to the aquarium... |Map Description
